items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: until we get serious and I think six or seven months went by and we got married.

ctx.x: and she had the umbrella and the umbrella was upside-down, you know, - forget it! - so we got a taxi and we went to the Apollo Theatre and we happened to find that Duke Ellington was there - and you know, he was my idol. He and Count Basie and Fletcher Henderson, you name it; so we went out there and had a tremendous time. When the thing was over, I took her home and I didn't see her maybe for ten days, but I forgot her name. I forgot the address.

I got an idea where she lived, so one day - gee, I was so desperate - because she was beautiful - and I went to the 3rd Ave., between - almost on the corner - 116th - and I see her mother, that she was drying her hair - because she was very clean, beautiful woman too - and I asked her - she was living one flight up - I said: "Lady, you know the girl that lives mmmmmmm? "Yes, but she is not here, she is working", you know, very stern, and I said: "Oh", this, this thing - Huh - so I was - I went by and I was…
Okay. Where did you get married in?
